name: convention-ignore-list-selection-key
description: A key that lists files a tool ignores is a selection key, so a string there roots no file, and a file only that key names is reported as never imported. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named stryker for the package @stryker-mutator/core whose selection keys hold mutate and ignorePatterns read from stryker.config.json, its range holding the installed version.
